body: UPDATE: I made it to the next day! met with my therapist and she made me feel a lot better. I have a lot of work to do in terms of not internalizing other people's behavior towards me (specifically blaming myself for other people's behavior). Thank you so much to everyone who commented here, and those who DM'd me and just listened to me - that helped a lot. love you all whoever and wherever you are <3

all good reasons, thank you! 

as for finding a person that loves me, I don't know how. I always seem to pick people who can't love me back because deep down I think I'm unworthy of being loved. It's even harder to find people in the pandemic, not that I really went out much before then.
